title: Mixed Event — What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic! — Episode4 For My Friends

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!
meta.Event Outline: Noticing Mizuki's lackluster attitude following the mystery tour, Ena grows worried. Her apparent concern for her friend doesn't go unnoticed by Airi and Shizuku, who extend an invitation to a picnic to both of them in hopes of lifting their spirits.

rows.Line: Highlands

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright... So we have to find the first panel and guess the name of a tree that looks like...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The map says that it should be around here somewhere too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, isn't that it by the base of that tree?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're right. It even includes two hints.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “Hint 1: They are often planted near shrines... Hint 2: Bluebottle butterfly larvae like to eat their leaves...”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's talking about camphor trees, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you know the answer?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I remember seeing this in a book and on a quiz show. The answers are supposed to be written on the back, so let's take a look...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup! The answer is, "Camphor trees."

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's so cool! Do you know a lot about plants, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Not really. I just happened to know this one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But are Ena and Shizuku gonna be okay? It looked like there were a bunch of bugs over where they were. I hope they don't get into trouble or anything...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nah, they should be fine.
Ena's tougher than she looks.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's true. Ena is pretty good at looking after people, me included...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Wait, this is getting more personal...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This could be a chance to learn more about what's bothering Mizuki... Just gotta find the most opportune moment and ask...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So you all meet up online to make songs as a group? That's gotta be pretty hard sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It actually isn't.
We're all a little weird, but everyone's really nice too so it's pretty fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see... That's good to hear!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hmm... I guess I won't get any real answers that easily, huh?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm also pretty glad that you became friends with Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You know how Ena is... She says what's on her mind and can rub people the wrong way, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah, totally.
Ena can be pretty ruthless sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We went to this cafe where you can make handicrafts called the sewing lounge the other day...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: After I finished drawing a sketch for something I was about to make, she was like, "There's no way this'll turn out cute!"

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's Ena for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, she can be so mean sometimes!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But after that, she sat down with me to think about how to make it better. That's kind of what I really like about her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know exactly what you mean.
She's done that a few times for me too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? She's helped you before too, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, she has.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Before I really started getting work as an idol, I was a regular junior high school student and Ena was in the same class as me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We didn't really talk much at first, but one day, some of my classmates started making fun of this variety show I appeared in...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's not like I was being bullied or anything, but I knew that people were talking about me behind my back. That was when Ena got mad...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She yelled, "You really think that's funny?!"

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Seriously? Man, she really has always been like that then...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right? I thanked her for what she did later, but she just replied, "I said that because I didn't like what was going on. That's all..."

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But what she did made me really happy. I'd never seen someone stand up for a stranger like that before...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Everyone stopped talking about me and I became friends with Ena after that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's nice...
Actually, that reminds me of something...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: E-Enanan?! What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I came to give Yuki a piece of my mind!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whenever she sees that someone's going through something, she just comes right out with it, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly! It's like she knows what to do when it really matters, which is why...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If there's something bothering you, Mizuki, I think you should talk to Ena about it. I'm sure she can help you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, hold on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And you're the one that's always talking about getting different perspectives on things. Seeing a pretty landscape might even give you some ideas for the video, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, stay on topic. I'm the one that's asking you if you want to come on this picnic.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So that's why she tried so hard to get me to go on this picnic...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Ena, you little fox...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But I get it now...
She's genuinely worried about me.)
Hiking Trail

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're doing great, Nene!
I'm getting plenty of good data too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No... No more... I'm taking these off... And taking a break...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, let's take a break.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: While you do that, I'll be trying out some of the other new props I brought.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe... Now, which do I start with first...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (How's Rui not tired? He's been lugging all that stuff the entire day...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I forgot to bring the "Star Training Suit"...!
I even brought the rope for it too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Star Training Suit? What's that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a sort of powered exoskeleton. It helps the user run, carry things and move around more easily.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words! Whoever wears this will be able to run, jump, move around and even carry massive objects while performing with little to no effort!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It still needs a few adjustments, but by tying this rope to Tsukasa, he could fly from one side of the stage to the other in one leap... Such a shame...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui, please try to remember that we're a theatre troupe, not a circus, okay...?
